settings.description: Show the full unit info panel in missions for squads you do not own: the commander's name, the soldier count, rank and experience, and the ammo menu with its weapons, instead of only the name and relation. The show_allied, show_neutral and show_enemy settings choose for whom. The ammo menu's weapon toggles stay inert for those squads unless ally_weapon_toggles allows them for allies. Squads only; vehicles and buildings keep the game's panel. Single-player: blocks online multiplayer while active. Restart required.
Show allied squads' full details. Restart required.
Show neutral and abandoned squads' full details. Restart required.
Show enemy squads' full details. Restart required.

Let the ammo menu's weapon toggles work on allied squads shown by show_allied, so you can tell an ally which weapons to use; the ally's AI keeps them. Enemy and neutral squads' toggles stay inert. Restart required.

The reload bar colour on your own squads' ammo cards. A colour is teal (the game's), green, yellow, grey-blue, red, or #RRGGBB. The bar colours need the Defiance unit inspection colours mod enabled in the game's MODS menu, which makes the bars greyscale; without it every bar keeps the game's teal. Restart required.
The reload bar colour on allied squads' ammo cards (teal, green, yellow, grey-blue, red, or #RRGGBB). Restart required.
The reload bar colour on neutral and abandoned squads' ammo cards (teal, green, yellow, grey-blue, red, or #RRGGBB). Restart required.
The reload bar colour on enemy squads' ammo cards (teal, green, yellow, grey-blue, red, or #RRGGBB). Restart required.
